summary: End-to-end verification of the NEW recall/re-publish feature across Officer console and Admin Historic Results tab. Added /app/backend/tests/test_recall.py (3 tests, all passing) covering: officer recall+republish cycle with standings & notifications assertions, admin-role recall permission, and auth-required guard. Playwright UI covered the full Officer flow (published->recall->setup badge->set-provisional-btn shown->publish-btn label switches to 'Publish Results'->back to dashboard shows race under 'In progress'->re-publish restores to Published section) and the full Admin Historic Results flow (hist-recall-btn -> hist-publish-btn toggle with API-level status verification). Also verified via in-browser fetch that /api/races/{id} returns status=setup with published_at=null after recall, /api/notifications includes the race while in setup, and standings drop and restore the race correctly. All data restored to published state after testing.
critical_code_review_comments: Officer RaceConsole.setStatus only navigates back on 'published'; on 'setup' it stays on the console (correct - lets officer review the recall). Confirmed behaviour matches UI intent.
POST /api/races/{id}/status/{status} uses require_officer which accepts both officer & admin tokens (verified by test_recall_admin_role_also_allowed). Good.
Admin HistoricTab correctly refreshes both current race and race list after status change (setStatus function). Good.
Minor UX note: on Officer console, recall-btn's window.confirm text mentions 'race-day notice will show again' — verified true via /api/notifications. Matches implementation.
test_credentials: Officer PIN sail2026, Admin PIN admin2026
seed_data_creation: None. Two races (Sonata Summer R3 id 36db894a... and Sonata Late Spring R6 id f516fcf7...) were recalled and re-published during testing; both restored to 'published' at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Recall feature fully verified. Backend endpoint POST /api/races/{id}/status/{status} is the single mutation used by both Officer (recall-btn/publish-btn) and Admin (hist-recall-btn/hist-publish-btn). GET /api/notifications returns objects keyed by 'race_id' (not 'id') — take note when asserting membership. Pytest requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var and -o addopts='' to bypass xdist requirement in pytest.ini.
rca of the issue: N/A — new feature verification, no bugs found.
